items.summary: Disposition: blocked for new public launches and security-sensitive releases; ordinary reversible growth may continue where existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, and platform-policy boundaries are preserved. SearchWoot must remain private. The concrete blockers are missing upstream redistribution rights, incomplete data-flow and retention evidence, incomplete GA4 consent/configuration evidence, incomplete vendor/logging/incident evidence, and blocked accuracy, measurement, and security gates. Fleet compliance is a technical baseline only: 36 pass, 19 fail, and 6 unknown, including 19 banner/consent/GA4 failure sets and 4 privacy/terms findings. Do not claim legal clearance or certification. Human counsel is required for Woot rights, public data display, historical derivatives, alerts, affiliate/advertising use, and jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment. Next evidence action: attach one dated read-only bundle covering the four existing SearchWoot legal tasks; do not send outreach, enable tracking, collect new data, or change production.
